notes: πᾶς + substantival article + participle was analysed one way at LUK.24.14 and another here. The chapter's reading elsewhere — quantifier bare, article takes the supplied nominal, participle takes the relativizer — is what rules 80, 102 and 32 require, so this verse is brought into line: πάντα keeps a bare 'all', τά takes 'things', and γεγραμμένα takes 'which are written'.
